shortBio.en: The Cure bassist on classic cold and Disintegration-era records; intermittent exits.
shortBio.zh: 经典冷声与 Disintegration 时期 The Cure 贝斯手；间歇离开。

body.en: Bass often carries early hooks (A Forest spine). Leaves and returns; long-run partner to Smith on later tours.
body.zh: 早期钩子常由贝斯扛（A Forest 脊椎）。离开又回归；后期巡演里 Smith 的长期搭档。
